name: Agents
description: An agent you text, with a browser of its own

services.name: Codex, Claude Code or OpenCode
services.detail: The brain you pick, downloaded from its maker and signed in with your own account. Your conversations go to it

services.name: Helium
services.detail: The agent's web browser, downloaded from its maker

services.name: The web
services.detail: Pages the agent opens and fetches: public websites only, never your computer or local network

services.name: npm
services.detail: Packages for the apps the agent makes

services.name: YouTube
services.detail: Previews of videos the agent shows in chat

credits.name: Claude Code
credits.detail: Anthropic's coding agent, run as published by Anthropic

credits.name: OpenCode
credits.detail: The open source coding agent, MIT

credits.name: just-bash
credits.detail: The agent's shell, run over its own home folder

requirements.name: Brain
requirements.detail: A Codex, Claude or OpenCode account (OpenCode also has free models)

requirements.name: RAM
requirements.detail: About 500 MB while the browser is on
